name: todo
description: Durable repository task routing with persistent per-task Codex threads, isolated Git delivery, and telemetry.

interface.longDescription: Routes repository mutations through durable local tasks, runs one Codex app-server per repository with a persistent thread per task, archives each thread between worker attempts and restores it for retries or reopen, validates connectors and Git state before atomic publication, executes in runner-owned worktrees, and records attempt telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Use $todo:route to route this repository change through ToDo.
Use $todo:run with a referenced task file to execute it in this thread.
Use $todo:status to show tasks and workers.
